status: prospective original plan before scoring; all scores development only
target: Sum positive Quantity for normalized completed, shipped or returned rows after exact deduplication, grouped by order date and product/store. Positive return-flagged fulfilled rows count gross; do not subtract as usable returns. Exclude cancelled, processing, and eight nonpositive rows. No use of revenue, historical Inventory_Level, or contemporaneous future status as predictors.
target_sensitivities: positive completed/shipped units with Return_Flag No (exclude returned units)
missing_dates: No global dates absent. On global dates, aggregate no local rows as zero RECORDED units only, after first observation; this is an observation target not a claim of stock exposure or zero underlying demand. No imputation of truly absent global dates. No pre-first-observation targets.
population: 336 historically seen product/store pairs with at least 364 calendar days since first observed transaction at origin; no future-sales eligibility filters. Operational snapshot not used to construct historical features. All observed pairs match current synthetic roster, but historical assortment not known.
training: At every origin use only order dates at or before origin. Ridge examples: Sundays from 2023-01-01, with 364 days of individual prior exposure and all outcome dates <= origin; latest two years of examples. Other methods use history to origin.
evaluation_dates: October 6-November 30, 2025 for 7-day target. Coverage comparison omits November 23 origin, so all 8-14 day targets end by November 30.

horizons.secondary: 8-14 day totals; synthetic lead time + 7 per pair. Separately compare each horizon over identical seven origins, plus pair-specific coverage. These scenarios do not establish historical ordering rules.

baseline: recent_91d: units over trailing 91 observed calendar days / 91, scaled by horizon. Not the exact incumbent.

sba_croston.formula: Initialize first positive size and elapsed days since first observation; smooth event size and interarrival gap only at nonzero events, daily rate=(1-alpha/2)*size/gap.

pooled_ridge.features: Per-series daily rates over 7,28,91,364 days; past-year 28-day same-season rate at origin-364, times horizon; pooled historical month-of-year multiplier times annual rate and horizon. Six features. Fit separate direct cumulative models for horizons 7..14; clip negatives to zero. No hyperparameter tuning.

primary_metric.name: MAE
primary_metric.units: absolute product units per product/store next-week total
primary_metric.weighting: Equal weight each eligible pair and each of eight origins. No revenue weights. Directly interpretable unit mismatch, symmetric because no shortage/overstock cost priority supplied; may favor low forecasts for sparse sales.

selection_rule: Choose lowest primary MAE. Exact numerical ties within 1e-10 favor recent_91d, then sba_croston, then pooled_ridge. No invented meaningful business-improvement threshold; report small/mixed gains candidly. Secondary diagnostics never override primary winner.
secondary_diagnostics: WAPE=sum absolute error / sum actual recorded units
origin/month results and fraction origins won vs baseline
pair macro error and wins; sparse/less-sparse segments defined by pre-origin training event rates
coverage horizon errors and pair-specific coverage
status target sensitivities with fixed methods, no selection changes
baseline 28/182-day window sensitivities (diagnostic only, not new selection candidates)
uncertainty: Development residual 10th/90th percentiles by horizon pooled across pairs, applied as signed additive residual offsets to point predictions and clipped nonnegative. Empirical illustrative ranges, not calibrated service-level bounds or independent coverage claims. Block-bootstrap origins for selected-minus-baseline MAE, fixed seed, 2000 draws; dependence/small origin count limits interpretation.
ordering_rule: Scenario only: ceil to supplied order multiple of max(0, predicted lead+review units + supplied safety stock - usable on hand - incoming due within coverage); if positive also meet minimum rounded to multiple. No double-count of on-order aggregate. Forecast horizon begins December 1. Flag cumulative daily expected demand exceeding stock+due deliveries before new-order arrival. No invented optimal buffer.
reserved_data: Do not read December outcomes or originals; future due dates in approved operational inputs allowed.
iteration: No iterative search planned. Retain original plan and scores. Any later model additions require append-only prospective new version and exploratory labels; no reserved outcomes.
measurement: Fresh process peak RSS via resource.getrusage (macOS bytes; Linux KB), includes full CSV preparation and all retained arrays and models; phase wall time fitting/inference separately and total run time. Environment and dependency versions recorded. RSS high-water cannot isolate independent phase incremental memory; record phase high-water with that limit.
